name: LookBack
tagline: Smart glasses that recognise people you meet and whisper context to start a conversation.
problem: In social settings the hard part is not knowing anything about the person in front of you.
solution: Glasses connected to an app identify people in real time and summarise names, shared interests and mutual connections.
demo_moment: Team-described: look at someone and see a summary of who they are.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won the 'Chaotic Evil' prize, which suits face recognition of strangers.

lessons: Joke categories can reward projects that are deliberately unsettling.
